article.title: After two decades, Palestinians prepare to vote for a new political leadership. But will it change anything?
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: Hamas, Islamic Jihad, and rival Fatah dissidents have united in an unprecedented coalition for the first Palestinian elections since 2006. But Israeli repression and foreign pressure raise doubts about whether free politics is possible under occupation.
